notes.title: 50,000$ donated to charity and a new, free Dagon DLC in the making!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we wanted to share a positive milestone today!

[b]More than 50,000$ (or 200,000 zlotys, for our fellow Poles out there) collected for charity[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/1bc48f2aff610c534286139a69e5bfd0fe6a32ef.png[/img]

We debuted Dagon in 2021 as a narrative experiment and our first non-comissioned game. It became a significant success, and [b]as of the latest transfer, together with you - players from all over the world - we have collected over PLN 200,000 / 50,000$ for charity[/b] (organisations such as the Polish Red Cross, Polish Humanitarian Action, Save the Children, or Voices Of Children)! Thank you!

We've also crossed [b]1,700,000 downloads[/b], which is kinda crazy.

[b]All DLCs on sale[/b]

All Dagon DLCs are currently discounted, so if you'd like to join our charity endeavours, you can grab them on sale (100% of net proceeds are donated to charity): 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27591

[b]One more thing...[/b]

We're also working on a free DLC for Dagon to thank our community for supporting our studio since 2021.

No release date yet, updates will drop as we're closer to release, so make sure to follow us on X/Twitter to stay up-to-date:

https://twitter.com/bit_golem


Until next time!

notes.title: Devils, witchcraft and dark arts: Mercyful Flames, a game inspired by Dagon and the classic movie Häxan - limited-time DEMO OUT now!
notes.content:
Asmodeus called to let us know that the demo for Mercyful Flames is now out!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/9d62d317a9c54e6dd2f3b952189e8c75f756c2bd.gif[/img]

The game is a [b]dark documentary [/b]based on the classic movie Häxan, and delves into the [b]history of devils and witches[/b]. It will only be available during Steam Next Fest (till 17th June), so don't miss your chance to delve into the diabolic arts!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/dcae3d06f03eac947eccfc5140ad3baca3a15702.jpg[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/052578548c291f429591a2ae8917652c86781636.jpg[/img]

Get it here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1066740/

One of the main [b]inspirations [/b]behind MF is [b]Dagon[/b], so if you enjoyed our adaptation of the cult H. P. Lovecraft story, there's a high chance this collaboration between Bit Golem (publisher) and Asmodev (developer) will be right up your alley.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/4ccc942480b17026865168162591bc259c09e535.jpg[/img]

Tha Asmodev Team would really appreciate [b]your feedback[/b], so feel free to drop it here on on the game's Steam forum. Thanks!

notes.title: Pool of Madness - New limited-time demo with new graphics and physics!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/bf6c625f7a5e7d0d21e214583938cdbb747f1b98.png[/img]

Steam [b]Endless Replayability Fest[/b] is here, and to celebrate, we're back with a [b]NEW limited-time demo[/b] for Pool of Madness, our Lovecraftian roguelite... pool!

The demo is now LIVE on our Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873750

The first demo was a huge success, resulting in [b]11,000 wishlists[/b] and a very enthusiastic response from players, which was an awesome surprise, as it was a very early build of the game created within a month since the internal game jam that spawned PoM. We've used your feedback to introduce some updates to Early Demo #2 - find the list below!

[b]Pool of Madness Endless Replayability Fest Demo - major updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] updated graphics, visibility & high resolution
[*] rewritten physics
[*] new feature: ability to freeze the ball (check Help), making the gameplay more dynamic and unique
[*] new phase, power bar, explosion & blood marks and other smaller changes!
[/list]

Please note that Pool of Madness is very much a work in progress and we're working on improving every aspect of the game. We're sharing an updated demo so we can continue gathering feedback from players early and shape the game together. 

So... grab the demo and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Pool of Madness - a Lovecraftian pool game with roguelite elements - exclusive x-days DEMO available NOW!
notes.content:
Adepts of forbidden arts!

We’ve recently had an internal 2-person game jam that resulted in a prototype of a Lovecraftian pool game with non-linear story and roguelite elements. Yes, you read that right - it’s quite a combination.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/51484ff163d5f6197715694b3fbad1542248ea73.gif[/img]

Early demo teaser: https://youtu.be/3xixpp_SLJQ

We’ve decided to release an early demo to gather some feedback at the stage where we still have a lot of flexibility regarding its direction, so don’t expect a polished experience and many features, but we’ve had a lot of fun with it and decided we’d like to hear your initial thoughts - check it out and let us know!

[b]The exclusive demo will only be available during Steam’s Lovecraftian Days, till April 8, so give it a spin![/b]

[b]Wishlist [/b]and try out Pool of Madness [b]DEMO [/b]on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873750

Feel free to drop your thoughts here on discord or on our Steam forums!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/5e72e16f859e56d18fb71e35f2e80d0ad70f6e89.png[/img]

notes.title: Valentine's Day update 💖
notes.content:
[b]Happy Valentine's Day[/b] fellow cosmic horror lovers! 

As a sign of our devotion to [b]the one who haunts our dreams[/b], we have just released an [b]update for Dagon[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312070/4e1c1fd3bdd841c1ed2e05bff9b417916193e184.jpg[/img]

This update contains:
[list]
[*] 2 new languages: [b]Ukrainian [/b]and [b]Arabic[/b]
[*] reduced [b]build size[/b]
[*] improved translations
[*] new Turkish font
[*] fixed problems with some of the [b]Achievements[/b]
[*] fixed problems with the gamepad usage
[*] dozens of small [b]fixes and improvements[/b] in scenes and UI
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361560


The Great Old One is [b]all alone [/b]in the sunken R'lyeh... Let's show him that we think about him as much as [i]he thinks about us[/i] on this special day!

notes.title: Our next project 🔥 A documentary game based on the movie from 1922!
notes.content:
Fellow friars.

We are burning inside with the desire to tell you about our [b]next project[/b]!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/b7359885a78f4eadcae0d4a46270511d707e3298.jpg[/img]

[b]Mercyful Flames: The Witches[/b] is a dark documentary game based on the [b]classic movie Häxan (1922)[/b] that delves into the world of devils and witches. 

Its gameplay is similar to [b]Dagon[/b], focused on story and atmosphere. The narrator will guide you through the history of witchcraft enriched with contemporary knowledge.

It’s a cooperation with fellow priests from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/asmodev]Asmodev [/url](creators of highly acclaimed mockumentary games) who hit on this idea.

[b]Follow [/b]and [b]wishlist[/b], the demo will be available soon👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1066740
